title: Ante de Mamey (Mamey Preserve)
description: A fruit preserve made with mamey, cake, and raisins.

ingredients.name: one and one-quarter pounds of sugar
one pound of mamey, well ground
one teaspoon of ground cinnamon powder mixed with six cloves

steps: Clarify one and one-quarter pounds of sugar
Add one pound of well-ground mamey
When it begins to set, add one teaspoon of ground cinnamon powder mixed with six cloves
Serve alone if desired, or place a layer of marquesote soaked in sherry on a platter, then a layer of the preserve
Decorate with raisins and chopped almonds

title: Ante de Manzana o de Membrillo (Apple or Quince Paste)
description: Prepared with apple or quince, sugar, and water.
steps: Cook the apple or quince with a small amount of water.
Remove the core and seeds from the fruit.
When cooled, strain the fruit without any water.
For 2 pounds of fruit, use 1 pound of sugar.
Place on fire, adding only the water in which the fruit was cooked.
After 1 hour of cooking, let it boil.
Pour into molds of desired shape and let cool.
The same method is used for guava paste.

title: Arequipa (Arequipa Sweet)
description: Prepared with rice flour, ground almonds, and sugar.

ingredients.name: one and one-half pounds of sugar
one and one-half ounces of well-sifted rice flour

steps: Clarify one and one-half pounds of sugar with very little water
Lower the heat and add one and one-half ounces of well-sifted rice flour, two ounces of peeled and ground almonds in their dry state, and one liter of milk
Place all over fire, leaving the almonds aside
When it is about to reach the proper stage, add the almonds dissolved in one-half liter of milk
When it reaches the soft-ball stage (punto de ante), pour into a platter

title: Atole de Elote con Leche (Corn Atole with Milk)
description: Prepared with corn, milk, and green beans.

ingredients.name: six to eight white corn ears
or alternatively: one dry chile, a small piece of burnt tamale, a small piece of cinnamon, two Chiapa peppercorns, salt, water

steps: Shuck about six to eight white corn ears
Grind them very well
Dissolve this with half a liter of water and strain through loose cloth, adding small amounts of cold water
Place on the fire without stopping stirring, with one small teaspoon of salt and half a pound of sugar
When it thickens, gradually add cooked milk little by little, as otherwise it will curdle
To test doneness, drop a small amount in a bowl of cold water; if it does not rise, it is ready
Cook tender green beans with salt and serve a little atole, then a spoonful of cooked corn kernels and sprinkle cinnamon powder on top

Alternatively, toast one dry chile, grind it with a small piece of burnt tamale, a small piece of cinnamon and two Chiapa peppercorns, dissolve with a little water and a few grains of salt, and sprinkle over the atole with a small cloth

description: Prepared with cod, tomatoes, and onion.

ingredients.name: Four to six large tomatoes per pound of cod
Half a French bread, fried in lard
One cup of cod cooking broth

steps: Soak and cook the cod as with previous recipes.
Roast four to six large tomatoes, four garlic cloves, three onion heads, and one fried guaque chile.
Grind this roasted mixture with a little oregano, a little cumin, some Castilian peppercorns, a small piece of annatto, and half a French bread fried in lard.
Mix this ground mixture with three tablespoons of good vinegar and one cup of the cod cooking broth.
Fry this mixture in one glass of oil.
Place the cod to boil for half an hour in this sauce.
When serving, if desired, add chopped pickled vegetables and well-cooked green peas.

title: Barquillos (Wafer Cookies)
description: A biscuit made with bread, melted butter, and milk.

ingredients.name: One pound of sifted bread flour
Half an ounce of vanilla essence

steps: Put half a liter of milk with half a pound of sugar in a bowl and beat until no granules remain
Add one pound of sifted bread flour and beat so it does not become lumpy
Add two ounces of melted butter
If too thick, add a little more milk and half an ounce of vanilla essence
Heat the wafer iron over charcoal fire
Pour in one large spoonful of batter; if the iron is large, three or four wafers can be made at once
Close the wafer iron carefully so they do not spread too much

title: Chiles Rellenos (Stuffed Chiles)
description: Prepared with chiles, pork, and lard.

ingredients.name: Twelve ounces of partially cooked pork meat (for ten chiles)
Bread powder ground with pepper, cinnamon, and clove
Zucchini, carrots, green beans, all chopped finely and cooked with salt (optional, instead of almonds and raisins)

steps: Place the green guaque chiles over coals that do not burn them
Put them in a pot and cover with boiling water
Cover and let them sit for ten minutes
Peel them easily
Open them in the middle and carefully remove the seeds with the tip of a knife
Leave them in water, changing it every two hours
If they are very spicy, you can add one tablespoon of sweetened vinegar
After one or two days in water (depending on preference), remove them and let them drain
Dry them with cloth
Chop partially cooked pork meat (twelve ounces for ten chiles)
Fry in one tablespoon of lard with tomato, onion, and one peeled and chopped garlic clove
Add one teaspoon of vinegar, salt, bread powder ground with pepper, cinnamon, and clove, chopped almonds and raisins, and if desired, a touch of sweetness
Alternatively, add finely chopped and cooked zucchini, carrots, and green beans with salt, in which case omit raisins and almonds but add capers
Fill the chiles with this mixture
Dust with flour
Dip in beaten egg
Fry in hot lard
Beat two eggs (first the whites, then the yolks) for ten chiles

Serve with a sauce of peeled and chopped tomato, onion, and one fried garlic clove, with one tablespoon of bread powder or one teaspoon of flour dissolved in water, with a touch of achiote color, and one cup of water with salt
Alternatively, serve with a sauce of cooked tomato ground with about ten or twelve capers, fried in a little lard, with water to make a thin sauce, seasoned with salt, and serve hot

title: Chompipe Relleno (Stuffed Turkey)
description: Prepared with turkey, pork, and bread.

ingredients.name: Pork meat (5 libras for large turkey)

steps: Hang the turkey and cut its tongue or throat
Once dead, place in a pan and pour a jug of boiling water, turning quickly so it does not boil over
Pluck and clean well, then burn some straw or twigs to remove all small feathers
Carefully cut the wings and legs without breaking them, cut the head and split the skin along the backbone
Carefully remove the meat leaving only the bones
Once well deboned, remove most of the fat and the top part that has no meat, cover with breast pieces trimmed from thick areas
Grind five libras of pork meat, passing it twice through the grinder until very fine
Once ground, add half an ounce of salt, a quarter ounce of Castilian pepper, half an ounce of cinnamon powder (if desired), four or five raw eggs and a spoonful of bread flour
Mix well and stuff the turkey
Cut half a libra of ham into long strips and insert inside the meat
Sew closed with thick thread the openings of the legs and wings
Wrap in a long cloth, sewing it very well and very tightly to press it
Place in a pan with water, salt, bay leaves, a sprig of thyme, a bunch of leeks, a bunch of parsley and two well-cleaned beef feet
Let boil four hours over very even heat
After this time place in a press while still very hot
The next day serve as desired

title: Chompipe Relleno a la Mexicana (Mexican-Style Stuffed Turkey)

When well mixed, stuff the turkey, sew it closed with thick thread
Place in a pan, rub with butter and salt, place two bay leaves and two onion heads on it

title: Chompipe Relleno al Horno (Oven-Roasted Stuffed Turkey)
description: Prepared with turkey, pork, and lard.

ingredients.name: one turkey with wings and legs
one güisquil or half if large
ten to fifteen tender green beans
ten to twelve peeled and halved almonds

steps: Debone the turkey leaving the wings and legs
Rub with salt and butter and let sit for one hour
Parboil four pounds of pork meat with salt, remove and chop finely
Place a pan over the fire with one tablespoon of lard, four peeled and chopped tomatoes, four onions and two garlic cloves
Add the meat with a small glass of vinegar, one glass of sherry, a little ground breadcrumb powder, eight cloves, eight Castilian peppers and one small piece of cinnamon
Add one tablespoon of sugar if you wish it sweet
Remove when half cooked
Have ready two carrots, chopped and cooked, half a güisquil (or whole if small), ten to fifteen tender green beans, four large potatoes and one cup of tender peas
Mix everything with the meat, adding one ounce of raisins, ten to twelve peeled and halved almonds, capers and olives
When well mixed, sew the turkey closed with thick thread
Rub the turkey with salt and butter, place four bay leaves, some cloves and Castilian peppers on it
Place in the oven for three hours, basting with its juices every fifteen minutes
Serve hot, garnishing with green lettuce

title: Choux à la Crème (Cream Puffs)
description: Prepared with cream, bread, and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: Four ounces of sifted bread flour

steps: Put one glass of hot water with salt, two tablespoons of sugar, two ounces of butter, and one fresh lemon peel in a pan
At the first boil, remove from heat, remove the lemon peel
Gradually add four ounces of sifted bread flour, stirring very well to avoid lumps
Place over very low heat, stirring constantly until a compact ball forms
Remove from heat and stir until cool
Mix in four eggs one at a time, ensuring each is well combined before adding the next
Place on a baking sheet in desired sizes, sprinkle with powdered sugar
Bake until cooked
Split in half and fill with cream filling (Crema de Leche)

title: Chuletas Fingidas (Mock Cutlets)
description: Prepared with pork, tomato, and onion.
steps: Cook the ribs with salt

Add raisins and almonds sliced lengthwise, salt, one cup of sweet sherry, a little bread powder mixed with clove, pepper and cinnamon
Prepare a dough with one pound of flour, four eggs, juice of three sweet oranges, half a teaspoon of salt, and one tablespoon of butter
Knead for half an hour until it crackles and is very fine

title: Cocido (Spanish Boiled Meat and Vegetable Stew)
description: Prepared with beef, leeks, and garlic.

ingredients.name: two pounds of very good beef brisket
two pounds of very good bone
half an ounce of well-washed rice
two ounces of chickpeas (soaked the night before)
ten crayfish, well washed with hot water (optional)
one chicken or half of a fat hen (optional)
one piece of tender güicoy squash
some small potatoes (if available), about four large potatoes
fried seasoning paste of tomato, onion, and minced garlic
one tablespoon of flour fried in lard or butter

steps: Put four liters of water in a pot and add two pounds of very good beef brisket and two pounds of very good bone
Add one tablespoon of salt, four to six leeks, one head of garlic, half an ounce of well-washed rice, and two ounces of chickpeas that have been soaked the night before
When it begins to boil, remove all the foam
From a medium height, let one liter of cold water fall into it
Let it boil for two and a half hours
If desired, add ten crayfish well washed with hot water, lifting their little caps and cutting the tips off their pincers, one sheep's head, one chicken or half of a fat hen
After all of this has boiled for two and a half hours, add one chayote squash, one piece of cabbage, two tender corn ears, two carrots, two white turnip roots, and one piece of tender güicoy squash
Add tender green beans, ichíntalo, some small potatoes if available (about four large potatoes)
When everything is cooked, serve the cooked or stewed meat on one platter
On another platter serve all the vegetables with slices of plantain steamed and pieces of black ayote squash, not forgetting to add tender green beans and ichíntalo to the cocido
The broth is used for all kinds of hearty soups by simply adding fried seasoning paste of tomato, onion, and minced garlic, one tablespoon of flour fried in lard or butter, and minced parsley

title: Empanadas (Stuffed Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with bread, lard, and potatoes.

ingredients.name: pound and a half of melted lard in which fine achiote is dissolved
one pound of good dried fish or cod
six tablespoons of sweet bread powder ground with four cloves

steps: Moisten two pounds of bread flour and one of lard with pound and a half of melted lard in which fine achiote is dissolved, four ounces of sugar and a little water
Knead for half an hour so the dough remains quite soft
After being well kneaded, let it rest for three hours; if possible it is better to make it from the night before
Chop six chayotes, two pounds of potatoes, ten or twelve large carrots
Cook everything separately, with salt
Cook chopped green beans and peas, all that is green with a little baking soda, being careful they do not fall apart
Soak one pound of good dried fish or cod
Put a pan on the fire with two ounces of lard; chop six large tomatoes and four onions

Once this is fried, add it to the well-drained vegetables, salt, four ounces of sugar, six tablespoons of sweet bread powder ground with four cloves, six Castilian peppers and a small piece of cinnamon, add the fish well broken into small pieces
Once everything is well mixed, remove from the fire

From the wet dough make thirty parts, according to the size desired for the empanadas, stretch with the wooden pin and fill with the vegetables, fold, crimp the edge and place on baking sheets in the oven

Cook one or two chickens with salt according to the amount of fiambre
Cook one or two cured tongues in the same broth; add twenty or thirty sausages, two pounds of lean dried beef, about ten blood sausages, ten eggs
When all is well cooked, let cool
Then chop, making sure everything comes out very whole; slice the tongue, slice the egg or lengthwise, cut the chicken in small pieces or chunks of desired size
Strain the chicken broth well, cover and let cool
Cut ham from the leg, whether York or local variety, well cooked

Peel with boiling water a pound of the largest shrimp available and cook with the fish

Prepare a bottle of very clean cold water, the chicken broth, an ounce of salt, a bottle of the finest olive oil, half an ounce of pepper powder, two small jars of English mustard, a bundle of parsley and one of creole mustard with four or five ground onions, ten or twelve peeled tomatoes
Mix everything well, add all the vegetables stirring them with the chopped meats, setting aside separately the slices of black and red chorizo, egg and blood sausage

title: Fricasé de Pollo (Chicken Fricassee)
description: Prepared with chicken, lemon or vinegar, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: one lemon or a little vinegar
a few drops of lemon juice or vinegar

steps: Put two ounces of butter with one teaspoon of flour in a pan; as soon as it melts add one glass of water.
Add a little pepper powder, a little nutmeg powder, and one lemon or a little vinegar.
If there are tender mushrooms, add them.
Add the chicken quarters with salt to taste.
Let it boil for three quarters of an hour.
Just before serving, add three egg yolks well beaten with a few drops of lemon juice or vinegar.
If using mushrooms, add them when the chicken is half cooked; if not, use cooked artichoke hearts.
To keep the chicken meat white, brush it with lemon.
